testcase.system-out: Scenario: Collapse and expands the drawing browser tree ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/blank-drawing.odd` is open in the MCAD Software with drawing resources and a sheet ✔ And the browser has expanded branches containing nested entries ✔ When the user opens the drawing browser menu ✔ And the user chooses Collapse All ✔ Then the drawing resources and sheet remain visible as collapsed branches ✔ And their nested entries are hidden ✔ And the drawing sheet remains visible ✔ When the user opens the drawing browser menu ✔ And the user chooses Expand All ✔ Then nested entries under the drawing resources and sheet are displayed ✔ And the drawing sheet remains visible
